admission.justification: An unbounded read would spend the store's bytes and pages before the declared limit applied.

applicability: Evidence packet and investigation reads whose declared byte, path, record, depth or page budgets bound the work.
conditions: The read or packet declares finite limits and the caller stays inside them.
exclusions: Repository-wide scans or checks outside the admitted bound.

evidence: A4-checks/probes.json: resumed-work-budget; focused F04/F16 source counters; source _Relations/_stream_names

statement: The declared evidence budgets must bound actual source/relationship work and packet populations, not only a text prefix after an unlimited read.
